strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FFTS_CLOAKERUNLOCK_DESCRIPTI: Stay stealthed for 30 seconds without being unstealthed for longer than 4 seconds.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FFTS_CLOAKERAKIMBOUNLOCK_DES: As Cloaker, complete a teleporter event without entering stealth once.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FFTS_CLOAKERSCREECHUNLOCK_DE: As Cloaker, mark 5 enemies without breaking stealth.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_DESCRIPTION:
The Cloaker is a methodical character who uses stealth in order to setup for high damaging strikes that reward kills with gold.<style=cSub>

< ! > You can remain permanently stealthed as long as you avoid running into enemies - make sure to weave through enemies without being detected!

< ! > Your first hit out of stealth is empowered with extra damage so using it with your secondary can lead to powerful bursts of damage.

< ! > Restealth gives an opportunity to stealth without being revealed by enemies. Use it to disengage or aggressively path to priority targets.

< ! > Make sure to combine your highest damage skills with Mark to cash in on its gold reward and skill reset.
</style>
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION: After <style=cIsUtility>{0} seconds out of combat</style>, become invisible and gain movement speed. While invisible, gain <style=cIsDamage>{1}% bonus damage</style>. Shooting, taking damage, or an enemy within <style=cIsUtility>{2}m</style> breaks stealth. Cooldown reduction reduces the delay.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PASSIVE_ALT1_DESCRIPTION: Replace passive stealth with <style=cIsDamage>{0}% bonus attack speed</style>. Hold Shoot to alternate pistols. Pistol hits do not apply marks.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION: Fire a precise bullet for <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION: Charge a shot for up to <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style>.</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION: Dash in your movement direction. With Cloak, enter stealth. With Akimbo, gain <style=cIsDamage>{2}% attack speed</style> for <style=cIsUtility>{3} seconds</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION: Mark a target within <style=cIsUtility>{0}m</style>, revealing it through walls. Hits dealing <style=cIsDamage>{3}% damage</style> consumes the mark and deals <style=cIsDamage>{1}x damage</style>. Consumed marks cannot be reapplied for <style=cIsUtility>{2} seconds</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SPECIAL2_DESCRIPTION: Unleash a shockwave for <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style> to enemies within <style=cIsUtility>{1}m</style>, knocking them back and applying Mark.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_MARK_KEYWORD: <style=cKeywordName>Mark</style><style=cSub>Cloaker's hits with a positive proc coefficient consume the mark and deal <style=cIsDamage>{1}x total damage</style>, with the bonus dealt as a separate hit. If either hit kills the target, gain <style=cIsUtility>3x the gold and experience</style>, stealth for <style=cIsUtility>{4} seconds</style>, and reset <style=cIsUtility>all skill cooldowns</style>.</style>
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_LORE: An unseen threat waits for the right moment.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_BODY_LORE: An unseen threat waits for the right moment.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_OUTRO_FLAVOR: ..and so they left, unseen once more.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_MAIN_ENDING_ESCAPE_FAILURE_: ..and so they vanished, leaving only an echo.
